text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan takes first place! She's the

strongest runner of her year! The title's
hers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah... That's right! I totally forgot
how great
Machan is!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She said she's not the best at this
distance, but
she went and won anyway!
Way to go, Aston
Machan!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So this is Aston Machan! I can't believe I
missed
my chance to talk to her before
the race!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm Aston Machan, and I'm right here.
Don't
forget.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I had my doubts in the
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Nobody had so much as a glance to
spare for me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm the one who chose to run sprints.
I don't
regret that decision.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? Vodka and Scarlet
are both
really great runners.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The thought of a race where those two
clash is
enough to get anyone excited.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That means I'll have to work harder than
ever and
dig even deeper if I still want
to leave my mark on
the path I've
chosen...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Starting with the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Right.
choice_data_list_en: Yeah...! We're definitely going to win.
Yeah...! We're definitely going to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Aston Machan starts walking
in the
opposite direction of the hotel we
booked, so I
rush out to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's Kyoto in the fall. I have to get some
pictures
with the foliage.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Do you want to come?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Aston Machan and I enjoy a
stroll around
the city, taking in the
vibrant red and orange
leaves.
